profile.headline: Software @ Salesforce
profile.jobTitle: Software Engineer LMTS (Lead Member of Technical Staff)

positions.title: Software Engineer LMTS (Lead Member of Technical Staff)
Sr. Software Development Engineer in Test
Lead Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
▪Functioned as lead test engineer on multiple projects, running scrums, planning testing cycles, working closely with upper management and key organizational stakeholders.
▪Led a team of Automation and Manual engineers and was responsible for mentorship, growth, performance evaluation and job satisfaction.
▪Lead a selenium automation effort for CommerceCloud using a Java/XML homegrown solution.
▪Flex position contributing to a Performance Engineering tool: Maestro in communities working with React, Node, Postgresql
▪Newman API automation testing.
▪Designed, tested, and implemented new features working face to face with customers.
▪Created, maintained and executed test planning for multiple products within a quarterly new feature release cycle.

positions.title: Sr. QA Software Engineer
positions.description:
▪Helped Implement two new products for Tesla merger: Approval and Sales Commissions.
▪Selenium WebDriver using C#.
▪Postman/Newman API automation testing.

positions.title: Software QA Engineer
positions.description:
▪Created and planned test plans as well as fully covered test case management for multiple web app and .NET service projects
▪API Testing with some automation but majority in 
Fiddler, Postman, and REST client
▪Web app manual testing
▪JIRA/GIT/TFS/Test Rail Proficient

positions.title: Desktop Support
positions.description:
▪Sharepoint Administration
▪AD, Exchange, SQL Server Support
▪Hardware & Software Troubleshooting
